title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Use case ID, outcome, persona, trigger, current workflow, pain, data, reach/frequency, impact/rationale, effort/rationale, uncertainty, business owner, technical owner, metric, next action

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: UC-01: find approved case guidance; support agent; ITSM + knowledge; impact high, effort pending permission/content review.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Each top case has evidence, uncertainty and owners; no generic agent wishlist.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Use case ID, impact H/M/L, effort H/M/L, quadrant, evidence, disputed assumption, sponsor agreement, revisit condition

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: High impact + low effort → Quick win; high/high → Strategic bet; low/low → Nice-to-have; low/high → Deprioritize.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Axes correctly labeled; IDs match the log; medium ratings discussed directionally, not mechanically forced.
